Rules Committee Resolution H. Res. 560 Reported to House. Rule provides for consideration of the conference report to S. 5. During consideration of the conference report, points of order against the conference report for failure to comply with clause 3 of rule XXVIII are waived. The conference report shall be debatable for 90 minutes, proportionally divided and controlled.
